PlayerKarteaConfig

class PlayerKarteaConfig(player, session, update_session_id, phase, level, level_time, vehicle_image, environment_image_right, environment_image_left, target_image, obstacle_image, positive_feedback_image, neutral_feedback_image, negative_feedback_image, positive_feedback_sound, neutral_feedback_sound, negative_feedback_sound, palette, hud, sound, feedback_image_time=0.0, object_arrival_time_1=6.5, object_arrival_time_2=3.3, object_arrival_time_3=2.2, feet_marker=False, feet_click=False, feet_click_time=1.2, horizon_image='horizon')[source]

Bases: ReflexiveModel

Model for player configuration in the Kartea game.

Attributes:
playerPlayer

The player associated with this configuration.

sessionPlayerKarteaSession

Last game session recorded in this configuration.

update_session_idbool

Whether each new game session is written to session (UPDATE_SESSION_ID_YES) or the recorded session is kept (UPDATE_SESSION_ID_NO).

phaseKarteaPhase

The game phase for this configuration.

levelKarteaPhaseLevel

The level within the phase for this configuration.

level_timeint

Time allocated for the level (in seconds).

vehicle_imagestr

Vehicle image resource (see KarteaResourceFields).

environment_image_rightstr

Environment image drawn on the right side of the track.

environment_image_leftstr

Environment image drawn on the left side of the track.

target_imagestr

Target image resource.

obstacle_imagestr

Obstacle image resource.

positive_feedback_imagestr

Positive feedback image resource.

neutral_feedback_imagestr

Neutral feedback image resource.

negative_feedback_imagestr

Negative feedback image resource.

positive_feedback_soundstr

Positive feedback sound resource.

neutral_feedback_soundstr

Neutral feedback sound resource.

negative_feedback_soundstr

Negative feedback sound resource.

paletteint

Number of the track color palette (key of KarteaPalettes.ALL); unknown numbers fall back to the default palette (0).

hudbool

Whether the heads-up display (HUD) is enabled.

soundbool

Whether sound effects are enabled.

feedback_image_timefloat

Time (in seconds, 0 to 2, step 0.1) the positive/negative feedback image stays on screen. 0 shows it for a single frame (original behavior). Defaults to 0.0.

object_arrival_time_1float

Time (in seconds, 5 to 10, step 0.1) an object takes from appearing on the road to reaching the car at speed 1 (levels 1 and 2). Defaults to 6.5.

object_arrival_time_2float

Same for speed 2 (levels 3 and 4): 3 to 5 s. Defaults to 3.3. Must be lower than object_arrival_time_1.

object_arrival_time_3float

Same for speed 3 (levels 5 to 7): 1 to 3 s. Defaults to 2.2. Must be lower than object_arrival_time_2.

feet_markerbool

Whether a marker (yellow dot) is drawn at the player’s real feet position during the game. Defaults to False.

feet_clickbool

Whether the player can select menu buttons with the feet, standing on a button for feet_click_time seconds. When enabled, the marker is always shown in the menus. Defaults to False.

feet_click_timefloat

Time (in seconds, 0.5 to 3, step 0.1) the player must stay on a button to select it with the feet. Defaults to 1.2.

horizon_imagestr

Horizon image resource, drawn behind the track (see KarteaResourceFields). Defaults to “horizon”. Comes last so that CSV files written before this column existed can still be loaded.

PROPERTIESClassVar[list[str]], class attribute

Field names of the class, filled by initialize_reflexive.

DATA_PROPERTIESClassVar[list], class attribute

Default value of each init field (dataclasses.MISSING when the field has none), filled by initialize_reflexive.

REF_PROPERTIEStuple[str, …], class attribute

Fields written as the referenced object’s id by get_data: player, session, phase and level.

UPDATE_SESSION_ID_NObool, class attribute

Value of update_session_id that keeps the recorded session (False).

UPDATE_SESSION_ID_YESbool, class attribute

Value of update_session_id that records each new session (True). Default for new configurations.

Methods

is_valid()

Check whether the required references are set.

set_data(data)

Update configuration data from a dictionary.

get_data()

Return configuration data as a list with one dictionary.

Notes

The image and sound fields hold resource names listed by KarteaResourceFields (built-in resources or files in the mods folder). The fields with defaults come last so that CSV files written before those columns existed can still be loaded.

Examples

>>> from types import SimpleNamespace
>>> config = PlayerKarteaConfig(
...     player=SimpleNamespace(id=1),
...     session=SimpleNamespace(id=10),
...     update_session_id=PlayerKarteaConfig.UPDATE_SESSION_ID_YES,
...     phase=SimpleNamespace(id=1),
...     level=SimpleNamespace(id=2),
...     level_time=60,
...     vehicle_image="defaultvehicle",
...     environment_image_right="right",
...     environment_image_left="left",
...     target_image="defaultstar",
...     obstacle_image="defaultobstacle",
...     positive_feedback_image="positive",
...     neutral_feedback_image="neutral",
...     negative_feedback_image="negative",
...     positive_feedback_sound="point",
...     neutral_feedback_sound="miss",
...     negative_feedback_sound="miss",
...     palette=0,
...     hud=True,
...     sound=True,
... )
>>> config.is_valid()
True
>>> data = config.get_data()[0]
>>> data["player"], data["session"], data["phase"], data["level"]
(1, 10, 1, 2)
>>> data["object_arrival_time_1"]
6.5
>>> data["horizon_image"]
'horizon'
